events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Easy. She's not stubborn, she's scared. Different problem, different rope.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: There. See? Nobody had to lose a hand today.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Better pay and my own say. I've quit for less and stayed for more.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: You held the string steady and didn't tell me how to do my job. That's rarer than you'd think.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: The Spread pays better. It just doesn't ask what I think of anything.
